notes: The Viaduct = Bd. Dacia from the Ciuflea/Bucuresti junction (z~1500) to Botanica (z~3385): 3 bridges (N ~300 m, middle ~130 m, S ~470 m) joined by 2 embankments (~1.6 km total). It does NOT cross the railway or the Bic: no railway within 1.7 km of it (OSM), the Bic is ~1 km NE. Under it: Malina Mica ravine + Str. Valea Podului (N), a wooded gully (middle), Valea Trandafirilor valley + Str. Melestiu (S).

All 4 data spans of each bridge (2 carriageways w=11.2 + 2 outer sidewalks w=2.2) must share ONE deck profile (the 'deck' list, keyed by z; x is the centreline between carriageways). Today each span gets its own straight line from its own end DEM heights, so sidewalk and carriageway decks differ by up to ~1 m at the north abutments (e.g. idx 172 north end -3.7 vs 262 -4.1 vs 181 -5.2).

Main terrain defect: the ground-filtered DEM still contains part of the deck: valley floors directly under all three bridges are 3-6 m too high (flat shelves / bumps along the stream thalwegs exactly at the viaduct). Apply the 'channel'/'cutting' lines as LOWER-ONLY corrections (min with DEM), blended over their side slopes.
Embankment lines: set terrain under the road corridor to the line (both raise and lower) and blend outwards with the slope.
Real carriageways are ~13 m (4 lanes) with a ~3.5 m concrete median (Esri measurement, +-1.5 m); data says 11.2 m with 16.7 m centreline spacing - acceptable.

Heights: absolute game frame (Arc ground = 0, = 86.2 m ASL). Deck values are estimates +-1.5 m unless stated; pier positions are evenly spaced at the measured ~33 m span (exact pier stations not verified).
